g.text: CD-3 — Human Review and Diagnostic Governance
+appendHumanReviewMetadata(UUID, UUID, String, HumanReviewDecision, Instant, String): void
Only IDs and sanitized metadata; no evidence content or comment
CORRECTED requires a nonempty actualCause; preserves the original version
Critical marking follows the approved policy; does not derive incident severity
Documented cross-cutting technical exception; not a Bounded Context
recommendation_service / Java / Spring Boot / status: proposed
Logical CQRS / same PostgreSQL instance / dependencies through interfaces
CONFIRMED validates; CORRECTED requires actualCause; REJECTED rejects without a validated alternative.
PENDING is derived from the absence of a review; it is not persisted in HumanReview.
Risk classification and critical marking require an approved policy; no invented thresholds.
Cross-cutting auditing to audit.audit_events with sanitized metadata and correlation IDs.
